name: LunaShift Mission Planner
focus: Integrated online/offline geometry with a simple source choice and guided SPICE setup
changes: Automatic, JPL Horizons, or NASA SPICE in Mission Setup
Managed, pinned compatible NASA kernel downloads and date-coverage checks
Normal visibility, energy and repair workflows can prepare SPICE tracks
Explicit source modes never silently switch engines
Actual-provider provenance, source comparison, and legacy workspace compatibility
Mac, Windows and Colab setup; human illustrated guide
limitations: Opening example is synthetic. Real tracks do not replace synthetic terrain.
DE421/MOON_ME_DE421 is pinned for consistency, not claimed to be the newest ephemeris.
Network/package downloads were blocked in the build environment; actual kernels must be checked on the user machine.
Finite sampled terrain and time intervals; generic energy and Earth-centre RF models; not flight certification.
